aboutGame.title: What is the Deltarune Kris Fight?
paragraphs: The deltarune kris fight is the heart of DELTARUNE's turn-based combat. Kris leads the party as its tactician, choosing FIGHT, ACT, ITEM, SPARE, or DEFEND every turn while you steer the red SOUL through bullet patterns on the battle board. Kris, Susie, and Ralsei each fill a distinct role, and coordinating their turns is the difference between a clean win and a wipe.

From Chapter 1's Chaos King and the secret boss Jevil to Chapter 2's Queen, GIGA Queen, and Spamton NEO, the deltarune kris fight grows harder with every chapter. Grazing bullets builds Tension Points for healing and spells, ACT commands fill Mercy meters for pacifist runs, and violence routes trade EXP for a much darker story.

highlights.detail: Queue FIGHT, ACT, ITEM, SPARE, or DEFEND for Kris, Susie, and Ralsei each turn.

Keep at least one healing item ready before every phase transition.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers about the deltarune kris fight, its bosses, and how to survive each phase.

items.question: What is the deltarune kris fight?
items.answer: It is the turn-based battle system at the heart of DELTARUNE, where Kris leads Susie and Ralsei while you dodge bullet patterns as the red SOUL.

items.question: How do I get better at the deltarune kris fight?
items.answer: Practice grazing bullets for Tension Points, DEFEND before heavy phases, and keep Ralsei's healing ready so the party survives longer encounters.

items.question: Which bosses are part of the deltarune kris fight?
items.answer: Major encounters include the Chaos King, Jevil, Queen, GIGA Queen, and Spamton NEO, each with its own attack phases and tactics.

items.question: Can I finish the deltarune kris fight without defeating anyone?
items.answer: Yes. ACT commands and SPARE fill the Mercy meter, letting you complete fights peacefully on the pacifist route.

items.question: Where should I start with the deltarune kris fight?
items.answer: Begin with the beginner guide, then move on to the walkthrough and boss guides as the encounters get harder.
